name: Visão Geral & Negócio
description: Volumetria e fluxo de processamento de Pedidos (HTTP & RabbitMQ)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'Total Criados' FROM Transaction WHERE name = 'WebTransaction/SpringController/api/orders (POST)' AND httpResponseCode LIKE '2%' SINCE 1 hour ago
SELECT count(*) AS 'Total Processados' FROM Log WHERE message LIKE '%Evento de pedido processado com sucesso%'   AND entity.name = 'Order Platform API' SINCE 1 HOUR AGO

SELECT   (filter(count(*), WHERE message LIKE '%Pedido criado com sucesso%') -    filter(count(*), WHERE message LIKE '%Evento de pedido processado com sucesso%'))    AS 'Pendentes'FROM Log WHERE entity.name = 'Order Platform API'SINCE 1 HOUR AGO

SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE (name = 'WebTransaction/SpringController/api/orders (POST)' OR name = 'WebTransaction/SpringController/api/products (POST)') AND (httpResponseCode LIKE '4%' OR httpResponseCode LIKE '5%') FACET name, httpResponseCode SINCE 1 HOUR AGO

widgets.title: Fluxo de Criação vs Processamento (Minuto a Minuto)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'Order Platform API' FACET cases(WHERE name LIKE '%OrderController%' OR name LIKE '%/orders%' AS 'Pedidos Criados (HTTP)', WHERE transactionType = 'OtherTransaction' OR name LIKE '%Rabbit%' AS 'Pedidos Processados (Queue)')TIMESERIES 1 minute SINCE 1 hour ago
